_about: Independent design axes. A 'direction' picks one option per axis. Tags drive soft affinity with the product brief; platforms restrict where an option makes sense; conflicts list option ids that can't co-exist. Edit freely: add options, retire ones you're tired of.

options.name: Editorial asymmetric grid
options.desc: 12-col grid used off-centre: wide text column + narrow margin notes, images breaking the grid.

options.name: Bento mosaic
options.desc: Tiles of deliberately unequal size; the biggest tile is the hero idea. Tile sizes follow importance, not symmetry.

options.name: Single-column narrative scroll
options.desc: One reading column, chapters revealed in order; the page reads like a story.

options.name: Sticky split-screen
options.desc: One half pinned (visual/product), the other half scrolls through content that changes the pinned side.

options.name: Full-bleed media-led
options.desc: Edge-to-edge imagery/video carries the page; text sits in disciplined overlays or between frames.

options.name: Index / catalogue list
options.desc: Dense typographic list rows (name, meta, preview on hover/tap) instead of cards.

options.name: Cockpit dashboard
options.desc: Persistent nav rail + workspace; panels sized by task frequency; filters always in reach.

options.name: Spatial canvas
options.desc: Content placed on a pannable/zoomable plane or map-like surface instead of a page.

options.name: Card deck / swipe stack
options.desc: One focused card at a time, swiped or stepped through; progress is physical.

options.name: Swiss modular grid
options.desc: Strict modular grid, flush-left ragged-right type, alignment does all the work.

options.name: Conversation-first
options.desc: The primary surface is a dialogue/prompt; everything else is summoned from it.

options.name: Timeline / journey spine
options.desc: A vertical or horizontal spine organises content by time or steps; position = meaning.

options.name: Tab-bar hub with hero feed
options.desc: Native mobile structure: 3–5 tabs, a home feed led by one large contextual card.

options.name: Poster stack
options.desc: Each section is a full-viewport poster with its own composition; scroll flips posters.

options.name: Characterful grotesk
options.desc: Sans with quirks in the details; confident without shouting.

options.name: High-contrast display serif + quiet sans
options.desc: Big fashion-y serif headlines over a neutral sans body.

options.name: Bookish text serif throughout
options.desc: One serif family for everything; reads like a well-set book.

options.name: Soft variable serif
options.desc: Warm, wonky, high-personality serif display; friendly sans body.

options.name: Slab sturdy
options.desc: Slab serifs: dependable, typewriter-adjacent, honest.

options.name: Condensed poster
options.desc: Tall condensed caps used huge; body stays plain.

options.name: Wide / extended
options.desc: Wide letterforms that take up space; futurist or streetwear energy.

options.name: Rounded friendly
options.desc: Rounded terminals, generous x-height; approachable and legible.

options.name: Mono-led technical
options.desc: Monospace carries headings and data; sans for long text.

options.name: Neutral precision sans
options.desc: Quiet, tight, information-first; personality comes from layout and colour.

options.name: Geometric clean
options.desc: Circles-and-lines geometry; modern, open, optimistic.

options.name: Classical old-style
options.desc: Old-style serifs, small caps, ornaments used sparingly.

options.name: Retro-digital
options.desc: Pixel/terminal display faces as accent, readable sans body.

options.name: Hand-made accent
options.desc: A handwritten/brush accent face for small human moments, clean body.

options.name: Neutral + one loud accent
options.desc: 90% neutral, one saturated colour reserved for action and the signature moment.

options.name: Duotone
options.desc: Two colours only (plus tints); every element is one or the other.

options.name: Tonal single hue
options.desc: Many tints/shades of one hue; hierarchy by lightness, not by hue.

options.name: High-chroma pop
options.desc: Several saturated colours assigned to sections or categories.

options.name: Muted earth
options.desc: Clay, olive, ochre, stone; grounded and tactile.

options.name: Pastel field
options.desc: Soft pastel surfaces with one deep colour for text and actions.

options.name: Deep dark luminous
options.desc: Dark (not black) base with luminous accents that glow.

options.name: Colour-block sections
options.desc: Whole sections flooded with solid colour; transitions between blocks are the rhythm.

options.name: Cool clinical
options.desc: Cool whites, steel blues, mint; crisp and trustworthy.

options.name: Jewel tones
options.desc: Emerald, sapphire, garnet, gold on deep grounds; rich and ceremonial.

options.name: Sharp
options.desc: 0–2px radius; crisp rectangles; lines and alignment do the styling.

options.name: Soft hierarchical
options.desc: Radius scales with size (chips 6, cards 16, sheets 28); nested radii stay concentric.

options.name: Pill & capsule
options.desc: Fully rounded controls and tags, rounded-rect containers.

options.name: Organic blob
options.desc: Irregular, hand-drawn or blobby shapes for containers and masks.

options.name: Notched / cut-corner
options.desc: Chamfered corners, tabs and notches; industrial or ticket-like.

options.name: Arches & circles
options.desc: Arch-topped images, circular frames, curved section edges.

options.name: Outline / line-art
options.desc: Hairline-outlined containers, no fills; drawings over surfaces.

options.name: Flat colour
options.desc: No shadows; separation from colour and space only.

options.name: Elevation scale
options.desc: 3–4 defined shadow levels tied to meaning (resting, raised, overlay, modal).

options.name: Translucent layers
options.desc: Frosted/blurred surfaces over rich backgrounds; used only where context behind matters.

options.name: Borders & rules
options.desc: 1px rules and hairlines define structure; surfaces stay flat.

options.name: Tactile texture
options.desc: Paper grain, noise, risograph or fabric texture on surfaces.

options.name: Dimensional 3D
options.desc: Rendered 3D objects, isometric scenes or depth parallax as the hero material.

options.name: Hard offset shadow
options.desc: Solid, unblurred offset shadows and thick outlines (neo-brutal, sticker-like).

options.name: Still & quiet
options.desc: Almost no motion; instant, crisp state changes; only feedback animates.

options.name: Snappy functional
options.desc: 120–200ms ease-out transitions that explain state changes; nothing decorative.

options.name: Springy playful
options.desc: Spring physics, overshoot, squash on press; delight on primary actions.

options.name: Cinematic scroll
options.desc: Scroll-scrubbed sequences, pinned scenes, one orchestrated story.

options.name: Ambient drift
options.desc: Slow background motion (gradients, particles, shader) that never competes with content.

options.name: Kinetic type
options.desc: Type itself moves: reveals, rolling numbers, variable-axis morphs.

options.name: Airy
options.desc: Generous whitespace, few elements per view, large type.

options.name: Balanced
options.desc: Comfortable reading density; standard 8pt rhythm.

options.name: Dense pro
options.desc: Compact rows, smaller type, power-user layouts, keyboard-first.

options.name: Real photography
options.desc: Art-directed photos of real people/places/products; consistent grade.

options.name: Flat / vector illustration
options.desc: Custom illustration in the palette; one consistent style.

options.name: Abstract generative
options.desc: Code-drawn patterns, gradients, shaders or noise fields.

options.name: Product UI as hero
options.desc: The interface itself, cropped and staged, is the imagery.

options.name: Typography only
options.desc: No pictures; type, colour and layout carry everything.

options.name: Data as image
options.desc: Charts, maps or diagrams used as the main visual material.

options.name: Collage / cut-out
options.desc: Cut-out photos, torn paper, mixed media layered with type.

options.name: Line-drawn symbols
options.desc: Fine line drawings, diagrams, glyphs or constellations.

options.name: Oversized type hero
options.desc: Headline set at a size that becomes the image.

options.name: Live demo in the hero
options.desc: The real product works right there: type, tap, see the result.

options.name: Scroll-scrubbed film
options.desc: One pinned sequence that plays as the user scrolls.

options.name: Data centrepiece
options.desc: One beautiful, true chart or map that tells the core story.

options.name: Colour-flood transition
options.desc: Background colour changes as sections enter; the page changes mood.

options.name: Stacking sticky cards
options.desc: Cards pin and stack as you scroll, building a pile of ideas.

options.name: Horizontal scroll gallery
options.desc: One section scrolls sideways, like a film strip.

options.name: Generative background
options.desc: A living shader/particle field reacting to cursor or time.

options.name: Character / mascot
options.desc: An illustrated character who guides and reacts.

options.name: Before / after reveal
options.desc: A slider or toggle that shows the transformation the product makes.

options.name: Delightful primary action
options.desc: The main button/gesture has a crafted, memorable micro-interaction.

options.name: Interactive globe / map
options.desc: A map or globe the user can spin to explore.

options.name: Personalised reveal
options.desc: The UI asks one thing and rebuilds itself around the answer.

options.name: Marquee / ticker
options.desc: A moving band of words, logos or live numbers.

options.name: Cursor / touch spotlight
options.desc: Pointer or finger reveals hidden layers, light or detail.

options.name: Plain & confident
options.desc: Short declaratives, no adjectives doing the selling.

options.name: Warm & human
options.desc: Second person, kind, conversational, small encouragements.

options.name: Witty
options.desc: Dry humour in empty states and microcopy; never in errors.

options.name: Understated premium
options.desc: Few words, lots of space, no exclamation marks.

options.name: Precise technical
options.desc: Exact nouns, numbers and units; tells you what will happen.

options.name: Poetic
options.desc: Evocative, rhythmic, image-rich — for headlines only; UI copy stays plain.
